Gold.note: Central bank buying and rate cut expectations support safe-haven demand.

Silver.note: Industrial demand remains resilient despite recent price pullback.

Copper.note: Structural supply deficits and green energy transition drive long-term demand.

Uranium.note: Structural supply deficit and renewed global nuclear capacity build-out.

Lithium.note: Near-term oversupply and slowing EV demand growth weigh on prices.

Nickel.note: Persistent surplus from Indonesian supply growth outweighs EV battery demand.

Zinc.note: Smelter treatment charge collapse reflects tight concentrate supply.

Iron Ore.note: Ongoing weakness in Chinese property sector pressures steel demand.

Coal.note: Adequate global inventories and renewable energy substitution cap upside.

Rare Earths.note: Geopolitical supply risks offset currently soft EV motor demand.

Manganese.note: Sluggish global steel production limits manganese ore demand.

PGM.note: Substitution effect from palladium to platinum and hydrogen fuel cell potential.

Potash.note: Balanced global supply and steady agricultural demand keep prices neutral.

Aluminum.note: Capacity caps in China and strong solar demand tighten primary supply.

Diversified.note: Balanced exposure to copper and gold offsets base metal cyclicality.
